description: Map of LMX1B domains, disorder and the three candidate LIR cores
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, re
seqs=json.load(open("seqs.json")); L=seqs["LMX1B_HUMAN"]
pl=json.load(open("lmx1b_plddt.json")); pl={int(k):v for k,v in pl.items()}
x=sorted(pl); y=[pl[i] for i in x]

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1, figsize=(11,6), sharex=True, gridspec_kw=dict(height_ratios=[1,1.4]))
a=ax[0]
a.plot(x,y,color="#2b6cb0",lw=1.2)
a.axhline(50,color="grey",ls=":",lw=1)
a.axvspan(308,317,color="#f6ad55",alpha=.5)
a.set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT"); a.set_title("Human LMX1B (O60663): candidate LIR motifs sit in a disordered C-terminal region")
a.annotate("308-317 SYTPLAPPQQ\nmean pLDDT 45.7", xy=(312,46), xytext=(340,78),
           arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->"), fontsize=9)
a.text(100,92,"LIM domains\npLDDT 85.2",ha="center",fontsize=8)
a.text(245,92,"homeodomain\npLDDT 89.2",ha="center",fontsize=8)

b=ax[1]
b.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((1,0.45),402,0.1,color="#cbd5e0"))
for s,e,lab,c in [(45,105,"LIM1","#4c51bf"),(106,165,"LIM2","#4c51bf"),(217,276,"homeodomain","#2f855a")]:
    b.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((s,0.35),e-s,0.3,color=c,alpha=.8)); b.text((s+e)/2,0.5,lab,ha="center",va="center",color="w",fontsize=8)
b.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((308,0.3),10,0.4,fill=False,ec="#dd6b20",lw=2))
cores={107:"Y107 QQL (DYQQL)",309:"Y309 TPL (SYTPL)",356:"F356 HDI (SIFHDI)"}
for p,lab in cores.items():
    b.plot([p],[0.72],marker="v",color="#c53030")
    b.text(p,0.78,lab,ha="center",fontsize=8,rotation=0)
b.text(313,0.22,"deleted segment 308-317",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#dd6b20")
b.text(107,0.12,"buried in LIM2\n(Zn-finger core)",ha="center",fontsize=7,color="grey")
b.text(356,0.12,"matches ELM canonical LIR\nbut not deleted in the study",ha="center",fontsize=7,color="grey")
b.text(309,0.12,"X2 = Pro311\nfails ELM canonical LIR",ha="center",fontsize=7,color="#dd6b20")
b.set_ylim(0,1); b.set_yticks([]); b.set_xlabel("residue"); b.set_xlim(0,410)
for s in ["top","right","left"]: b.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
